cards.q: What is the function of the nucleus?
cards.a: Contains genetic material (DNA) and controls the activities of the cell.

cards.q: Where does aerobic respiration take place?
Name two structures found in plant cells but not animal cells.
cards.a: Any two of: cell wall, chloroplasts, permanent vacuole.

cards.q: What is the cell wall made of in plants?
What is the function of ribosomes?
How does a prokaryotic cell store its DNA?
cards.a: As a single loop in the cytoplasm (not in a nucleus), plus small rings called plasmids.
